claim: Former President Donald Trump who lost the popular vote by 3 million has nominated a full third of The United Supreme Court, as of 13th October 2020.
justification: High-confidence evidence confirms that Donald Trump served as President of the United States from January 20, 2017, to January 20, 2021, meaning on October 13, 2020, he was not a former president, explicitly refuting a substantial part of the claim. While Trump lost the 2016 popular vote by nearly 3 million and had nominated three Supreme Court justices by that date, the claim's inaccuracy regarding his presidential status on the specified date warrants a refuted verdict.
